sources.supports: Term 1–3 fixed courses, term 4 choice of major, term 5 elective 30 hp, term 6 major and thesis, degree requirements
Term 4 major choice: business administration continuation package or economics advanced courses; HT2026-specific guidance

termRequirements.note: Official HT2026 instructions name the choice and business-administration package but do not establish a complete 30 hp course-level list for both choices in this review.

termRequirements.options: Courses in Sweden or abroad; do not count every option cumulatively.

termRequirements.thesisHpEvidence: Degree requirements on official programme page specify independent work of 15 hp; exact term-six course combination still needs verification.

dataQualityNotes: The source table has a term-four choice row without a numeric hp value; earlier parser omitted it. Do not interpret the missing row as no term-four study.
Term-six row is labelled Valbar on the programme page but includes major-area studies and thesis; the row is a mixed requirement, not 30 hp of unrestricted electives.
A source row named Valbar kurs can have type Obligatorisk: classification must consider both name and requirement semantics, not only type.
